origin.question: For Part 4, may I use this definition of a healthy run: living population stays at or above 10% of its starting count; no single exact DNA action/direction pattern occupies over 90% of the population for 128 consecutive seasons; and reproduction and varied actions continue? I propose evaluating this through 2,048 seasons on four comparison seeds, then two reserved confirmation seeds. Runs that hit the existing time limit would remain inconclusive. These definitions resolve the ecological criteria left open in the proposal.
